subject: general
question:
The graph below represents the number of bikes sold over a period of seven months. Observe the graph and answer the question that follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b73f9bba58c26c0347d49523e3a9a00141154708e9c4edbba2071a03bd4124c.png] 

What is the approximate percentage increase in average sales between the period January to March and the period April to June?
solution:
Average sale from January to March = (200 + 300 + 100)/3

⇒ 600/3

⇒ 200

Average sales from April to June = (200 + 400 + 500)/3

⇒1100/3
